program.title: BSc in Ocean Science and Technology
uncertain: total_required_credits (91.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups (pre-requisite 6 + required 52 + elective 12 + IRE track 6 + Marine Ecology Option 9 + Oceanography Option 6). The PDF does not state a single overall major total, and this figure double-counts the mutually exclusive Marine Ecology / Oceanography options and the optional IRE Track.
Required Course(s) uses lower-bound credits for the ranged groups (capstone 3-6, MATH 3-4, PHYS 3-4) and treats LIFS 1901 and LANG 4010 as 0 where a waiver may apply.
MATH 1012 was deleted (last offered 2024-25) but remains in the PDF list.

groups.name: Major Pre-requisite course(s)
groups.note: Students MUST take the following courses prior to enrollment into the major.

courses.name: The Earth as a Blue Planet
Principles and Applications of Environmental Science

groups.name: Required Course(s)
groups.note: Credit ranges resolved to lower bounds: fixed OCES core (34); capstone OCES 4964 OR (OCES 4974 AND OCES 4984) OR (SCIE 3500 AND SCIE 4500) = 3-6 (min 3); CHEM 1011 (3); LIFS 1901 = 0-3 (min 0; waived for students with HKDSE Biology level 3 or above) plus LIFS 1902 (3); MATH 1012/1013/1020/1023 = 3-4 (min 3); PHYS 1101/1111/1112/1312 = 3-4 (min 3); COMP 1021 (3); LANG 4010 = 0-3 (min 0; IRE Track students are exempted and take LANG 3027 instead). Lower-bound total = 52.

Ocean Science and Technology Research Project I

From Report to Presentation: Mastering Effective Communication in Environmental Impact Assessments

groups.name: Elective(s)
groups.note: Ocean Science and Technology Electives: courses from the specified elective list. Students taking the Marine Ecology Option must use OCES 4301 to count towards this elective requirement, while those taking the Oceanography Option must use MATH 1014. Courses taken to fulfill the Track/Option requirements may not be counted towards this elective requirement.

courses.name: Applied Linear Algebra and Differential Equations

groups.name: International Research Enrichment Track - Required Course(s)
groups.note: Students in the IRE Track should also take SCIE 3500 and SCIE 4500 as specified in the major requirements.

courses.name: AI and Machine Learning in Marine Science

groups.name: Marine Ecology Option - Elective Course(s)
groups.note: With approval by the program office, students should enroll in one of the Ocean Science Options. Students may opt to graduate with or without an option. Students taking the Marine Ecology Option should also take OCES 4301 as the Major Electives; 3 courses from this elective list.

groups.name: Oceanography Option - Required Course(s)
groups.note: Students taking the Oceanography Option should also take MATH 1014 as the Major Electives.

courses.name: AI and Machine Learning in Marine Science
